text: The shop owner decides to expand the inventory, bringing in exotic pets to attract even more customers.

text: Jorge worries about the increasing difficulty of keeping the children in the shop.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: As the sounds of sirens grow louder outside, Jorge decides to barricade the doors and prepare for a long night.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: An unusual creature, resembling a hybrid of a rabbit and a mountain lion, grows in size before her eyes.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: The creature lunges toward the observer, its eyes gleaming with a predatory hunger.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: Driven by greed, his father ignores all rational arguments.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: The son confronts his father, desperate to make him see the devastating consequences of his actions.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: Jorge argues that keeping the increasingly large animal in a store is dangerous and suggests it should be moved to a zoo.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: As Jorge speaks, the small creature suddenly bursts from behind the shelves, leaving chaos in its wake.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: He worries that the creature's appetite might exceed the supply of dogs from the pound.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: He devises a plan to regulate its feeding schedule and monitor its growth closely, but soon realizes the creature is far more clever than he anticipated.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: Alberto reassures someone by confidently stating that it appears content.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: Just as Alberto finishes speaking, the creature suddenly lunges forward, revealing its true nature.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: A character reminds someone about the upcoming anniversary of their parents' wedding.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: The child nods eagerly, determined to plan a surprise celebration for their parents.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: Jorge acknowledges that he must manage the shop alone.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: As the door swings shut behind his partner, Jorge takes a deep breath and prepares for the unexpected rush of customers.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: Jorge arrives the next morning to begin his feeding routine before the closure.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: As Jorge enters the barn, he discovers that one of the stalls has been left open and a thrashing sound is coming from inside.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: He realizes the children's cage is empty upon entering the room, having neglected to lock the door.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: Realizing the danger, he spins around, heart racing, as the sound of laughter echoes down the hallway.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: He desperately cries out, but there is only silence in return.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: A sudden rustle from the bushes reveals the lost item, shining under the moonlight.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: Frantically searching, he finds that the animal is completely missing from its cage.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: He turns to the forest beyond the cages, sensing that the animal has fled into the dense underbrush.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: The cachildrun observe him closely from their perch on a shelving unit above.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: The cachildrun suddenly pounces, landing squarely on his shoulders and sending him tumbling to the ground.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: It observes its prey with intense focus, poised like a lion ready to strike.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: The creature lunges forward with fierce precision, ready to strike its unsuspecting target.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: A swift, deadly force attacks Jorge, tearing into his flesh before he can defend himself.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: Jorge screams in agony as the creature drags him into the shadows, leaving only a trail of blood behind.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: As Jorge pushes the creature away, it lunges at him, causing him to fall into a display of chew toys.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: Jorge scrambles to his feet, grabbing a chew toy as a makeshift weapon against the aggressive creature.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: Jorge struggles to crawl to the front door while an unseen force grips him tightly from behind.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: Desperate and in pain, Jorge fights to free himself from the door's grasp as it tightens its grip.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: Jorge bleeds out as his life slips away amidst the gruesome violence.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: The room falls silent as the last breath escapes Jorge's lips, leaving only a haunting stillness in the air.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: In a horrifying scene, a creature feasts on Jorge with an insatiable appetite.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: The creature grows stronger, preparing to hunt for its next victim.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: After satisfying its hunger, it approaches the front door.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: It turns the doorknob slowly, preparing to step outside into the night.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: The creature carefully opens the door and escapes into the outside world.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: As the creature steps into the moonlit night, it takes a deep breath of fresh air, finally tasting the freedom it has longed for.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: A dense cluster of trees across the street promises a fresh new home.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: The stray dog sprints across the street, eager to explore the shelter of the trees and settle into its new territory.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: A figure ambles across the highway and into the cover of the trees.

title: Dark_Is_the_New_Light
text: The creature vanishes into the dense foliage, leaving only an eerie silence behind.
